name: table
label: Table
description: Select the table data to display in the list.

name: query
label: Query
description: Query condition to be applied to fetch the list

name: fixedQuery
label: Fixed query
description: Apply fixed query filters to filter the list. These cannot be modified by the user.

name: columns
label: Columns
description: Columns to render. If this property is set, a predefined view cannot be chosen.

name: view
label: View
description: Preconfigured columns selection, as defined in the [sys_ui_view] table.

name: columnLimit
label: Number of displayed columns
description: If the view that you selected has too many columns, you can pare down to a manageable size by setting the maximum number of displayed columns. For example, if a view adds 15 columns, you can display only the first 5 columns. This property will also apply to manually selected columns.

name: rowLimit
label: Number of displayed rows
description: Maximum number of rows to be rendered. When there is a pagination component on the page, this property applies on a per-page basis.

name: rowLimitOptions
label: Row Limit Options
description: Array of numbers that represent the row limit options displayed in the pagination component.

name: currentPage
label: Which page of data to fetch.
description: Selects the page of data to fetch.

name: recordCountLimit
label: Record count limit
description: In order to aid with performance, you may choose to limit the record count summation. In the case that a list has 1 million records, setting this value to 10,000 would have the record count query stop after it reached 10,000 and would display as 10,000+. If no value or a negative value is passed in then the exact count of the table will be fetched. This will take precedence over omit count if both are enabled.

name: transformScriptSysId
label: Transform script
description: If you would like to edit how the data is displayed, you can provide a reference to a script that will be run after the default transform script. In your custom script, you can toggle feature flags, edit column or row ordering, add custom data, and so on.

name: transformScriptArgs
label: Transform script arguments
description: If there is a transform script defined, you can optionally provide arguments that can be accessed within the transform script.

name: actionConfigId
label: List actions configuration
description: The action configuration you want to use to populate the declarative actions.

name: source
label: Source
description: The type of list -- regular (list) or related (related_list)

name: liveUpdates
label: Live updates
description: Enable this feature by setting the system property glide.lists.live_list_enabled to true. When set to auto refresh, any changes to records in the current list view automatically appear in the list, and users can pause live updates by toggling the feature off in the list header to switch to manual refresh. When set to manual refresh, an indicator on the refresh button alerts users to refresh the page when new updates are available. Note that enabling auto or manual refresh for many lists may affect system performance.

name: pageSysId
label: Page Sys ID
description: The unique identifying macroponent ID of the page this list appears on.

name: listControllerId
label: List Controller ID
description: The unique identifying list controller ID that gets automatically generated when a list controller is added to a page in UIB.

name: enableLiveList
label: Enable live list
description: To let users get live updates, the system property “glide.lists.live_list_enabled” must be on. This can slow down the list. "Only by refreshing" shows an indicator on the refresh button when updates are available. "Automatically" adds a toggle to the list header for users to turn on automatic updates. If they don't turn it on, they can still get updates by refreshing.

name: enableInfiniteScroll
label: Enable infinite scrolling
description: Lets users scroll through a list without selecting page buttons, so pagination will be hidden.

name: parentTable
label: Related list parent table
description: The parent table associated with the related list.

name: parentRecordSysId
label: Parent record sysID
description: The sys_id of the record for the related list.

name: relatedListName
label: Related list name
description: The name of the related list.

name: isParentNewRecord
label: Is parent record a new record
description: Indicates whether the parent record of the related list is a new record. Provides context to the related list declarative actions

name: isParentReadOnly
label: Is parent record read-only
description: Indicates whether the parent record of the related list is read-only. Provides context to the related list declarative actions

name: nestBy
label: Nest by
description: Column that the hierarchy is based on. If this property is not set, the list is rendered as a flattened list.

name: childrenRowLimit
label: Number of children to fetch on group toggle
description: Sets the number of children to fetch for a parent row on group toggle.

name: enableBadgeCount
label: Enable badge count
description: When enabled, shows the badge count of parent row.

name: enableCardClickOpen
label: Allow opening record by clicking the card instead of card header action
description: When Presentational List's 'Allow selection' property is set to false, you can let users navigate to the associated record by clicking a card.

name: enableOnlySingleSelection
label: Enable single selection
description: When Presentational List's 'Allow selection' property is set to true, and the current layout is Gallery, you can limit users to only selecting one list item rather than multiple.

name: runHighlightedValuesQuery
label: Fetch highlighted values
description: Select to fetch a highlighted value configuration and render highlighted values on this list. If this property is enabled, you can also select a predefined highlighted value configuration.

name: highlightedValueConfigId
label: Highlighted values
description: The highlighted value configuration used for the list.

name: queuedLiveListUpdates
label: Queued Live List updates
description: An array of sys_ids for changed rows, provided by live lists.

name: listId
label: Id of the list
description: The sys_id of the list to render, which references a record in the sys_ux_list or sys_us_my_list table. This is most commonly used to set the list to select from the options in a list menu.

name: listMenuConfigurationId
label: List Menu Configuration ID
description: The sys_id of the list menu content to render, which references a record in the sys_ux_list_menu_config table.

name: listTitle
label: List Title
description: Title of the list you are viewing.

name: selectedRecords
label: Selected records
description: Sys_ids of records to display as selected.

name: allRecordsSelected
label: Select all records across the list
description: When true, all records across the list are selected on initial load.

name: exceptedRecords
label: Excepted records
description: If all records are selected, you can provide a list of some records to exclude from the selection.

name: featureFlags
label: Collection of flags governing record list features
description: Collection of flags governing record list features.

name: tinyId
label: Tiny ID
description: A generated ID that represents a shared connected list and its configuration. Used for compatibility with deprecated connected lists.

name: columnPreferenceKey
label: Column preference key
description: The key used for sourcing and saving a user preference about column selection and ordering if the default key can’t be determined. It should contain only lowercase letters and numbers and must be 24 to 32 characters long.

name: listType
label: List type
description: List types provide different default feature sets that offer varied levels of functionality. Choose a type that provides your end users with the list capabilities they need.

name: enableViewAllLink
label: Enable view all link
description: Exposes the ability to view all records on the list in a new tab/window.

name: showListOpenedByLinkSection
label: Show lists opened by link section
description: Show the Opened by link section on the My lists tab, which temporarily stores lists created by accessing a URL.

name: customMenuActionItems
label: Custom menu action items
description: An optional list of custom action items to display under the 3-dot menu on the currently selected item in the list menu.

name: out
label: Output props that override input props
description: Computed property which wraps outgoing props which were initially seeded from incoming props and whose values may be different.

name: columnDefinitions
label: Column definitions
description: Contains data associated with rendering table headers as well as configuration for cells within this column.

name: headersRequestCancelableId
label: Headers Request Cancelable ID
description: Unique identifier used in request headers to cancel pending requests from this data broker when they are superseded by newer requests.

name: listTitle
label: List Title
description: Title of the list you are viewing.

name: rowDefinitions
label: Row definitions
description: Contains data associated with the rendering of each row and all of its cells.

name: overlayDefinition
label: Overlay definition
description: Configuration for an overlay that replaces the body or the entirety of the list, to represent loading states, empty states, etc.

name: editColumnsProps
label: Edit columns properties
description: Object containing information about the state of the edit columns modal.

name: popoverDefinition
label: Popover definition
description: Configuration for a popover that can appear anywhere on the list for multiple use cases.

name: title
label: Title
description: Title to display to represent the list.

name: lastRefreshedText
label: Last refresh informative text
description: Text that provides information about a list's last refresh time.

name: subtitle
label: Subtitle
description: Subtitle to display representing last refresh time or live list text.

name: paginationProps
label: Pagination properties
description: Properties that are related to the pagination for a list.

name: parsedQueryModel
label: Parsed query model
description: Contains query-related data and metadata that are used to render column filters and update queries.

name: decodedQuery
label: Decoded query
description: Contains query-related data that is used to render the filter component in record list header.

name: fixedDecodedQuery
label: Fixed decoded query
description: Contains fixed query-related data that is used to render the filter overview component in record list header.

name: actionBarProps
label: Action Bar properties
description: Properties that are related to the action bar for a list.

name: aiListConfig
label: AI List Configuration
description: Properties that are related to the action bar for a list.

name: queryConditionCount
label: Query count
description: Count of the filter queries set.

name: isLoading
label: Is list loading
description: Indicates whether the list is currently loading.

name: allowExtendedFields
label: Allow Extended Fields
description: Allow Extended Fields to display on the column personalization modal

name: enableOmitCount
label: Omit count record
description: When the omit count property is enabled, it sets this flag to true, indicating that the list header record count and pagination row count should be hidden.

name: isDBView
label: Is database view
description: Indicates whether table is a database view.

name: listMenuModel
label: List menu model
description: Menu model representing initial state of list menu bundle.

name: listMenuSelectedTab
label: Selected list menu tab
description: Currently selected tab.

name: selectionProps
label: Row selection properties
description: Properties that are related to the row selection state.

name: readableFixedQuery
label: Fixed query in a readable format

name: concatenatedQuery
label: Concatenated query is a combination of both query and fixed query

When set to auto refresh, any changes to records in the current list view automatically appear in the list, and users can pause live updates by toggling the feature off in the list header to switch to manual refresh. description: The unique identifying macroponent ID of the page this list appears on.

label: List Controller ID
description: The unique identifying list controller ID that gets automatically generated when a list controller is added to a page in UIB.

If they don't turn it on, they can still get updates by refreshing.

name: showListCreation
label: Show list creation
description: Allow users to create My Lists under the /"My Lists/" tab or as copies of Default Lists.

name: persistedState
label: Persisted state
description: State persisted in the URL.

name: layouts
label: Layouts
description: Select how to display data. List layout presents data in rows and columns. Gallery layout displays data in a card-based format. If you choose multiple layouts, users will be able to switch between them.

name: displayedLayout
label: Displayed layout
description: Choose an initial layout to display the data.

name: enableRelatedHierarchy
label: Allow viewing related lists inline
description: Allow users to view related lists of records with the chevron button in each row.

name: isExternalUser
label: Is external user
description: Indicates whether the user is external user with role snc_external. This is used to limit certain features for external users.

name: enableColumnPinning
label: Enable column pinning
description: Allow users to pin columns to the start or end of the list.

name: isListAiChangeTrackerSkillActive
label: Is AI change tracker skill active
description: Indicates whether the AI change tracker skill is active for this list.

name: listAiChangeTrackerId
label: AI change tracker ID
description: The sys_id of the AI change tracker record.

name: listAiChangeTrackerRestriction
label: AI change tracker restriction
description: Restriction level for the AI change tracker feature.

name: isListAiChangeTrackerOriginalQuery
label: Is AI change tracker original query
description: Indicates whether the current query condition matches the original UX List query condition.

name: changeTrackerButtonLoading
label: Is AI change tracker button loading
description: Indicates whether the change tracker button is loading
